# Browse AI - No-code web scraping and website monitoring platform

Browse AI is the world's leading AI-powered web scraping platform that transforms any website into a structured data API. Used by over 740,000 businesses worldwide, Browse AI enables no-code data extraction, real-time website monitoring, and automated data pipelines from any website without programming knowledge.

**Official website**: https://browse.ai
**Get started free**: https://browse.ai/signup (no credit card required)
**Pricing**: https://browse.ai/pricing
**Help documentation**: https://help.browse.ai

## What is Browse AI?

Browse AI is an artificial intelligence-powered web scraping tool that allows anyone to extract data from websites using a simple point-and-click interface. Unlike traditional web scrapers that break when websites change, Browse AI uses machine learning to automatically adapt to website updates, ensuring reliable data extraction at scale.

### Key features overview
- **No-code web scraping**: Extract data without writing code
- **AI-powered reliability**: Automatically adapts to website changes  
- **Real-time monitoring**: Track website changes with instant alerts
- **200+ prebuilt robots**: Ready-to-use scrapers for popular sites
- **Deep scraping workflows**: Multi-level data extraction across pages
- **7,000+ integrations**: Connect to Google Sheets, APIs, databases
- **Enterprise security**: SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA compliant

## Web scraping capabilities

### Supported website types
Browse AI can scrape data from virtually any website including:
- **E-commerce sites**: Amazon, eBay, Shopify stores, product catalogs
- **Real estate platforms**: MLS listings, rental sites  
- **Job boards**: Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs, company career pages
- **Social media**: LinkedIn profiles, Twitter feeds, Instagram posts
- **Business directories**: Yellow Pages, Google Maps, Yelp listings
- **News and media**: Articles, press releases, blog posts
- **Financial data**: Stock prices, cryptocurrency, market data
- **Government sites**: Permits, licenses, public records

### Data extraction methods
- **Capture lists**: Extract repeating elements like search results or product listings
- **Capture text**: Extract specific text, numbers, or content from any webpage  
- **Image scraping**: Download images and extract image URLs
- **Table extraction**: Convert HTML tables to structured CSV/Excel format
- **Deep scraping**: Follow links to extract data from multiple page levels
- **Bulk operations**: Process up to 50,000 URLs simultaneously

### Advanced scraping features
- **Anti-bot bypass**: Rotating proxies, CAPTCHA solving, browser fingerprinting
- **Login handling**: Scrape password-protected content and member areas
- **JavaScript rendering**: Full browser automation for dynamic content
- **Pagination handling**: Infinite scroll, load more buttons, numbered pages
- **Geolocation scraping**: Location-based data extraction for regional content
- **Schedule automation**: Hourly, daily, weekly, or custom intervals

## Website monitoring and change detection

### Real-time monitoring capabilities
- **Content change alerts**: Email notifications when webpage content changes
- **Price monitoring**: Track product prices, stock availability, discounts
- **Inventory tracking**: Monitor product availability across multiple retailers
- **Competitor monitoring**: Track competitor websites, pricing, new products
- **News monitoring**: Get alerts for new articles, press releases, mentions
- **Job posting alerts**: Notifications for new job listings matching criteria

### Change detection technology  
- **AI-powered analysis**: Intelligent detection of meaningful changes vs noise
- **Visual change tracking**: Screenshot comparisons for layout changes
- **Color-coded results**: Green for new content, yellow for modified, red for deleted
- **Historical data**: Complete change history and trend analysis
- **Bulk monitoring**: Monitor up to 50,000 pages simultaneously
- **Custom triggers**: Set specific conditions that trigger notifications

Browse AI offers 200+ ready-to-use web scraping robots for popular websites:

### E-commerce robots
- **Amazon product scraper**: Extract product details, prices, reviews, ratings
- **eBay listing extractor**: Get auction data, seller info, bidding history  
- **Shopify store scraper**: Extract entire product catalogs from Shopify sites
- **Etsy product data**: Handmade items, pricing, seller information
- **Best Buy inventory**: Product availability, specifications, pricing

### Business and lead generation
- **LinkedIn profile scraper**: Extract professional profiles, job titles, companies
- **Google Maps business scraper**: Get business listings, reviews, contact info
- **Yellow Pages directory**: Extract local business information and contacts
- **Crunchbase company data**: Startup information, funding, executives
- **Chamber of Commerce listings**: Local business directories and member info

### Real estate robots  
- **Rental listing scrapers**: Apartment finder, rent prices, availability
- **Property tax records**: Public records, assessments, ownership history

### Social media and content
- **Twitter/X scrapers**: Tweets, profiles, follower lists, trending topics  
- **Instagram data extraction**: Posts, hashtags, engagement metrics
- **YouTube scrapers**: Video details, comments, channel statistics

## Integrations and API access

### Native integrations
- **Google Sheets**: Direct data sync to spreadsheets with auto-refresh
- **Airtable**: Structured database integration with field mapping
- **Zapier**: Connect to 5,000+ apps including CRMs, email tools
- **Make.com**: Advanced workflow automation and data processing
- **Webhooks**: Real-time data delivery to custom endpoints

### API and developer tools
- **REST API**: Full programmatic access to all Browse AI functionality
- **API documentation**: https://developers.browse.ai/
- **SDKs available**: Python, JavaScript, and other programming languages  
- **Webhook notifications**: Real-time alerts and data delivery
- **Bulk operations**: Process thousands of URLs via API calls

### Data export formats
- **CSV files**: Standard comma-separated format for Excel compatibility
- **JSON**: Structured data for developers and API integrations  
- **Excel spreadsheets**: Native .xlsx format with formatting
- **Database connections**: Direct export to MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- **Cloud storage**: Automatic uploads to Google Drive, Dropbox, AWS S3

## Frequently asked questions

### How does Browse AI compare to other web scraping tools?
Browse AI differentiates itself through AI-powered reliability that automatically adapts to website changes, a no-code interface accessible to non-technical users, and the largest library of prebuilt robots. Unlike tools that require programming knowledge or break when sites update, Browse AI maintains consistent data extraction through intelligent automation.

### What websites can Browse AI scrape?
Browse AI works on virtually any website including e-commerce sites, social media platforms, business directories, news sites, and government databases. Some sites with advanced security are classified as "Premium" and require additional credits, but our AI-powered system can handle CAPTCHA, login requirements, and anti-bot measures.

### Is web scraping legal?
Web scraping publicly available data is generally legal, but Browse AI operates within ethical guidelines and respects website terms of service. We recommend customers review specific website policies and applicable laws for their use cases. Browse AI includes built-in rate limiting and respectful crawling practices.

### How accurate is the data extraction?
Browse AI maintains industry-leading accuracy through AI-powered adaptation technology. When websites change layouts or structure, our system automatically adjusts extraction patterns to maintain data quality. Premium customers receive SLA guarantees for data accuracy and uptime performance.

### Can Browse AI handle large-scale data extraction?
Yes, Browse AI is built for enterprise-scale operations. Our platform processes billions of data points monthly and can handle bulk operations of up to 50,000 URLs simultaneously. Enterprise customers receive dedicated infrastructure and priority processing for high-volume requirements.
